title: OOD Detection for EEG-based Machine Learning in High-Risk Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.17620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models for electroencephalography (EEG) analysis show great promise across a wide range of applications, but their deployment in high-risk domains is hindered by their vulnerability to distribution shifts. Encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) data can lead to catastrophic, overconfident predictive failures. While OOD detection methods can mitigate these risks, they remain heavily under-explored for EEG. Moreover, evaluations in the broader literature typically evaluate OOD detection performance in isolation, ignoring their practical impact on downstream applications. To bridge this gap, we introduce a benchmark for EEG OOD detection, evaluate a broad range of methods, and furthermore evaluate their value in two clinical downstream prediction task. translated_title: 基于脑电图机器学习在高风险环境中的分布外检测
translated_abstract: 用于脑电图（EEG）分析的机器学习模型在广泛应用中展现出巨大潜力，但其在高风险领域的部署受到对分布偏移脆弱性的阻碍。遇到分布外（OOD）数据可能导致灾难性的、过度自信的预测失败。虽然OOD检测方法可以缓解这些风险，但在EEG领域它们仍未得到充分探索。此外，更广泛文献中的评估通常孤立地考察OOD检测性能，忽略了其对下游应用的实际影响。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个EEG OOD检测基准，评估了多种方法，并进一步评估了它们在两个临床下游预测任务中的价值。我们的结果厘清了OOD检测与模型不确定性估计能力——这两者在文献中经常被混淆——并为高风险场景中的可靠部署提供了可操作的见解。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对脑电图机器学习的高风险环境OOD检测基准，评估多种方法并揭示其在临床下游任务中的实际价值，同时厘清了OOD检测与不确定性估计的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first benchmark for EEG OOD detection in high-risk environments, evaluates multiple methods and their practical value in clinical downstream tasks, and disentangles OOD detection from uncertainty estimation.
